item.title: Kubernetes Community Day Kochi — Years of Persistence, One Incredible Day
item.description:
Back in the early 2020s, we started CNCG Kochi alongside AWS User Group Kochi with a clear intent — build a strong meetup culture and create a platform for learning and knowledge sharing.

KCD Kochi was always on our wishlist. But instead of rushing, we focused on the fundamentals — consistent in-person meetups, growing the community from scratch, and earning trust.

As the community grew, we made a commitment: bring Kubernetes Community Day to Kochi.

item.title: CKA Certification
item.description:
Introduction

Well, finaly my results came to my inbox this morning. Super excited to share that I have cleared CNCF’s CKA Certiciation. It’s been a while I was planning for this one and decided to sit and prepare during the lockdown period.

Kubernetes

Kubernetes is an open-source container-orchestration system for automating application deployment, scaling, and management. It was originally designed by Google, and is now maintained by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.
